name: capturing-corrections
title_zh: 你改口一次它就记一笔的会话外记忆抽屉
tagline_zh: 当你说「不对，重来」「其实我想说的是」或「以后都别这样」——它把这些从对话流里捞出来，存成下次还能调用的项目偏好。
tagline_en: When you say "wait, no", "what I meant was", or "never do that again"—it catches those moments and saves them as.
desc_en: Use when the user corrects course, restates something already said, rejects an approach, or states a preference that should outlive this session — and when they say "remember this", "write that down", or ask what has been recorded for a project.
why_zh: 它不靠关键词触发，而是识别「纠正、重述、否决、立规矩」这四类语用动作。
why_en: It detects pragmatic moves—corrections, restatements, rejections, rule-setting—rather than keywords, turning scattered implicit.
limit_zh: 只认文本对话中的纠正与偏好声明；不处理文件、图片或语音里的隐含信息。存下的条目不带时间戳和来源上下文。
limit_en: Text-only; ignores implicit cues in files, images, or audio. Saved entries lack timestamps and source context—tag them yourself for cross-project use.
title_en: A session-proof drawer that files every correction you make
